auditScope: Original CI run 38176821997 attempt 1 only; offline artifact arithmetic and semantic evidence audit; no local run substitution.

method.quantiles: Nearest rank: sorted[ceil(n*q)-1], including upper order statistic on p50 and null empty quantiles.
method.numericComparison: Exact equality; every mismatch retained. The all-numeric inventory excludes booleans.
method.clock: Observer latency and worker meter are separate monotonic readings; epoch Date.now timestamps have millisecond granularity. No observed window is rounded to nominal.
limits: Primitive recorded CPU, memory, loop-delay, observer latency, counters and payload hashes cannot be independently remeasured without omitted underlying samples/bytes; numeric validity and all available algebra/aggregation are checked.
Source manifests are internally fingerprinted and cross-matched; this script does not independently fetch or rehash original CI checkout blobs.
Mixed worker cleanup RPC is present for four workers, but individual worker exit status/signal is not persisted.

Restart HTTP statuses, persistence row counts, cookie/CSRF, OBS payload protection and disk-secret checks are reported assertions; trace corroborates ordering/cleanup but does not contain original response bodies or dataset files.
Maps browser records 17 harness assertions, request URLs and clean exit; this audit cannot replay DOM assertions from result.json.
Loaded/quiet mixed windows change workload on the same candidate and are not RC16/candidate performance comparisons.

settings.clock: Request durations use observer monotonic clock; cross-process event/receipt times use the same-host Date.now epoch clock, millisecond resolution.
settings.scope: Real server, scheduler, auth-vault/ESI path and SSE protocol clients; no browser, physical OBS, GPU, internet or real player data. Legacy session backfill held fresh; live feed cursor enabled.

boundaries: Actual candidate supervisor, real forked child processes, runtime-child lifecycle, startKairo, HTTP/core/SQLite/ESI and frontend dataset-connection coordinator.
Actual dataset service stages a coherent copied-bundled generation through an injected fixture builder; actual prepare/commit/cleanup activates it. No full archive conversion is measured.
Supported fetcher options serve synthetic public ESI/CCP responses; noSync disables live periodic collectors; a synthetic identity requires no valid credentials.
HTTP accepted writes/reads and dashboard/OBS SSE use loopback networking. This is not a browser or OBS executable test.
A skills observation is injected through harness IPC into the real core bus and shipped Milestones subscriber; this remains asynchronous after session-owned travel made ship publication synchronous.
Two positive release schedules cover semantic completion before and after accepted HTTP completion. The latter waits at actual Core close, then releases names while SQLite remains open.
No release-after-close intervention and no child-exit grace. SQLite wrappers and controlled gates make this a diagnostic integration check, never an ordinary latency benchmark.
restart.safetyConclusion: For the old child being replaced, both controlled accepted-work schedules persisted the milestone before SQLite close, with no post-close operation or listener failure, and retained managed reconnect/session controls. Generation-2 final teardown is cleanup outside this assertion scope. This does not cover unreturned promises or arbitrary permanently stuck external work.
